verdict.rationale: TaxJar is a SaaS that holds customer transaction data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers an AI-training opt-out; the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies, or an opt-out control. The pack covers only the tax API, AutoFile, nexus tracking, integrations, and pricing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
